A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LT-Tuning study. Their complete text, equations, figures, tables and appendices support comparison, including matching v1 Appendices B–F to v2 Appendices F–J.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, component ablations, generation analyses, layer-selection experiments and qualitative examples.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds Qwen evaluations, GPQA-Diamond results and generated-text-token measurements in Appendices C–E.

M1.justification: The three-stage pipeline, fusion equation, adapter and Algorithm 1 are retained. However, new Appendix B.4 says the fusion weight is learned end-to-end, whereas B.6 calls it fixed and Table 10 retains the earlier value of 0.6. This contradiction prevents determining whether weight training actually changed.

E1.justification: v1 uses GSM8K training and four arithmetic evaluation benchmarks. v2 retains these and adds Bespoke-Stratos-17k training with GPQA-Diamond evaluation, explicitly extending coverage beyond arithmetic reasoning in Appendix D.

E2.justification: The original comparisons retain Explicit CoT, Coconut, Soft-Thinking, SoftCoT and SemCoT. New Qwen and GPQA experiments use the existing Explicit CoT and Soft-Thinking comparators; no comparator is removed from a corresponding original experiment. Newly cited SwiReasoning is not evaluated.

E3.justification: v2 adds Qwen2.5-0.5B and Qwen2.5-1.5B configurations, a Bespoke-trained Llama-3.2-1B zero-shot GPQA evaluation, and average generated-text-token measurements for Llama-3.1-8B. These substantially extend the evaluation design. The original Llama experiments retain their documented splits, budgets, hyperparameters and decoding settings.

E4.justification: Appendix E adds an analysis testing whether latent reasoning reduces explicit output length while preserving accuracy. Existing stage/component ablations, entropy and attention analyses, feature-collapse visualizations, layer sensitivity results and five qualitative examples are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions retain Figure 4's one-standard-error shading and the five sampling trials used to score question difficulty. v2 introduces no new empirical seed counts, repeated-run reporting, confidence intervals or significance tests; its theoretical noise model is not empirical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Original benchmark and ablation values are unchanged. New Table 4 reports Qwen LT-Tuning averages of 53.6 and 65.2, versus strongest-comparator averages of 52.3 and 62.7. Table 5 adds GPQA accuracy of 27.8 versus 25.7 for Explicit CoT. Table 6 adds overall text-token counts of 220.7 for CoT and 167.5 for LT-Tuning, a 24.1% reduction.

T1.justification: New Appendix B introduces an embedding-hull definition, complementary-error assumptions, propositions and proofs for predictive-embedding Bayes optimality, mismatch contraction and optimal scalar fusion, plus a mismatch-penalized objective and derived weight. v1 contains no corresponding theoretical development. The full-prefix rewrite of Equation 3 separately clarifies existing cached Transformer conditioning.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the central claims: confidence-driven latent reasoning, context–prediction fusion, a three-stage curriculum, mitigation of feature collapse and improved mathematical reasoning across Llama scales. The additional appendix evidence does not redefine the stated main contributions.

C2.justification: v2 adds interpretations involving complementary estimation errors, mismatch-dependent optimal fusion weights, cross-family/non-arithmetic applicability and reasoning compression. Figure 3 now warns against comparing absolute latent-token counts across scales. The new interpretation also introduces an inconsistency: Appendix B.5 identifies 'w/o Stage 3' with alpha=0, although Table 2 defines it as raw hidden states, corresponding to alpha=1.

D1.justification: v2 supplies limited setup guidance for the added experiments, including reuse of existing training/insertion/layer settings for Qwen and the Bespoke-Stratos-17k training source for GPQA. Original implementation tables, hardware, adapter and decoding details are retained. The printed repository URL replaces a label that already linked to the same destination in v1.

R1.justification: v2 adds SwiReasoning and distinguishes its block-level, training-free switching from LT-Tuning's token-level post-training approach. It also adds Min et al. (2025, 2026) and Fan et al. (2026), and removes the MetaMath reference while correcting Table 1's GSM8K citation to Cobbe et al. Overall positioning remains substantially intact.

P1.justification: v2 tightens the abstract, clarifies full-prefix conditioning, adds a fusion-rationale paragraph, funding/conflict disclosures and new appendix sections. Existing implementation appendices are relabeled and moved later. Most original prose and the main section sequence remain unchanged, rather than undergoing extensive rewriting.

P2.justification: v2 adds three experimental tables and an unnumbered theory-summary table. Existing figures and table designs are retained, with several plots relocated, Figure 3's caption expanded and subsequent appendix tables renumbered. The overall visual format remains the same.

improvement.justification: The Qwen and GPQA tests broaden evidence beyond v1's Llama/arithmetic setting, and Table 6 supplies previously missing evidence of shorter textual reasoning. Figure 3's comparability caveat also improves interpretation. These provide a limited net improvement: the new theory contains contradictory fusion-weight descriptions and an incorrect ablation interpretation, while text-token counts alone do not establish total compute savings.
